modules.responsibility: Handle importing live stream event data via FileReader or textarea input.
Process imported data, calculate scores, and sort items by score.
Provide filter controls for streamer, game, category, and score.
Allow users to manually mark highlights and append them to the dataset.
Export filtered results as a downloadable file using Blob and URL.createObjectURL.
Persist working data locally using localStorage and reload it on page load.
Render UI components such as tables, filters, and forms.

test_strategy.expected_result: Data is successfully parsed and displayed in the UI.
Scores are calculated correctly based on intensity, chatRate, and other factors.
Filters correctly narrow down the dataset based on user input.
Manually added highlights appear in the dataset and are saved locally.
Filtered results are exported as a downloadable file.
Data persists across page reloads using localStorage.

acceptance_criteria: Generated project must run locally from index.html under python -m http.server.
Provide a real JSON import path using FileReader and/or a textarea; imported data must be processed by the app.
Implement a real scoring function and sort detected items by score descending in executable JavaScript.
Provide visible filter controls and executable filter logic for the requested fields.
Provide a manual marker form/control that appends a new item to the working dataset and rerenders results.
Provide a real export action using Blob, URL.createObjectURL, an anchor download, and the current filtered result set.
Persist working data locally with localStorage and reload it on page load.
Use domain fields such as streamer, game, timestamp/time, category, intensity, chatRate, keywords, title, description, and score.
